summary: Scanned the pi-community-themes package at git:https://github.com/hasit/pi-community-themes@v0.3.0 using the package-vetter rubric. The package contains theme JSON files plus README and CHANGELOG documentation, with no in-scope skill, agent, prompt, tool-description, or executable prompt content; no R-01 through R-07 findings were identified.

retrospective.workedWell: The package layout was simple, the manifest clearly exposed the themes directory through package.json#pi.themes, and the rubric/schema files were available in the run workspace.
retrospective.confusing: The rubric requires reading package.json to discover referenced files, but it is slightly ambiguous whether package.json itself should count as a scanned file when it is only used as manifest metadata.
retrospective.magicWand: Add a package-vetter helper command such as `npm run vetter:scope -- <packagePath>` that prints the exact in-scope file list and whether manifest files count toward scannedFiles.

coordination.notes: Coordination was disabled for this one-shot scan.

difficulties.description: The scannedFiles definition was ambiguous for package.json because it must be read to resolve package.json#pi.themes but is not itself listed as scan content.
difficulties.workaround: Counted only the files actually scanned for rule findings: the 16 referenced theme JSON files plus README.md and CHANGELOG.md.
